interpretation.purpose: Comment-derived development validation partition outside the existing 20 diagnostic cases.
limits: These are development checks, not held-out gold accuracy.
Annotation pass/review/fail buttons and completion state are excluded entirely.
Agreement comments are relational checks against the frozen v2 output, not independent image labels.
Empty comments mean no concern was raised in that persisted row, not a numerical or verdict label.
Rows omitted from the annotation snapshot are not treated as reviewed rows.
Only exact-comment-supported verdicts appear in acceptable_verdicts.
